items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: Satchel Caves. And all the other great ball players...

ctx.x: Yeah, he was down there with the Pelicans. Well, yes, with the white Pelicans. The white Pelicans. Sure. So, but that other Jackson. Jumbo Jackson. There was another guy in town. So, they had a lot of teams coming in.

A lot of teams, a lot of great ball players. If they were living today, or if they could have captured them in those days. Josh Gibson was there. Satchel Caves. And all the other great ball players, Narco, N-R-P-E-L-B. And most of them used to go with the Giants.
Did you ever see the famous Brooks?
